item.title: Leitrim Climate Activist Urges Ireland to Lead by Example on Climate Action
item.description: A Leitrim climate activist is calling on Ireland to lead by example when it comes to efforts to tackle climate change. Leslie O'Hora, who's a Green Party representative based in Carrick-on-Shannon, says our weather is becoming even more unpredictable. He says this is a direct result of climate change and urgent action is now needed. Advertisement It follows major flooding in the east and southeast this week following Storm Chandra. item.title: Gardaí carry out more than eleven thousand checkpoints across region in 2025
item.description: New figures show Gardaí carried out more than eleven thousand checkpoints across the region during 2025. In the Mayo, Roscommon and Longford Division, a total of 8,767 checkpoints were conducted over the year. The Sligo-Leitrim Division recorded a further 2,730 checkpoints. Advertisement Gardaí say the checkpoints form part of a sustained effort to improve road safety, with a particular focus on detecting speeding, drink-driving and drug-driving offences. item.title: GoFundMe Launched to Support Young Leitrim Boy With Rare Condition
item.description: A GoFundMe has been set up to support a young Leitrim boy who was diagnosed with a rare birth condition. Oscar's mum Clare Lawlor Lynch said that during a routine scan at 18 weeks it was discovered her unborn son had Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia. To give Oscar the best chance of survival, she flew to Belgium for fetal surgery. item.title: Leitrim hold nerve to see off Waterford
item.description: A late Ryan O’Rourke free sealed a decisive Leitrim win over Waterford, 1-16 to 2-8 in a hard-fought contest in Carrick-on-Shannon. Leitrim made a sharp start and were on the scoreboard early through O’Rourke. Jack Kelly and Ben Guckain helped the hosts build momentum. Guckain was particularly influential in the opening half, converting a number of frees before striking the game’s first goal on 27 minutes. Guckain, burying the ball to the net to give Leitrim a commanding advantage. Advertisement
